title: Loi fédérale sur l'impôt fédéral direct (LIFD), RS 642.11
why_needed: Federal direct tax law: notification of the assessment (art. 116, art. 131) and objection (réclamation, art. 132 and 133), and every federal rule the engine cites.
notes: Consolidated text, état le 1er janvier 2026 (Fedlex filestore PDF/A, 116 pages). Art. 132 and 133 are on p. 71 of the PDF. The fedlex.admin.ch page needs a browser; this filestore link downloads the PDF directly. Check for a newer consolidation before each release.

title: Loi fédérale sur l'impôt anticipé (LIA), RS 642.21
why_needed: Swiss withholding tax (impôt anticipé): the 35 % rate on income from movable capital (art. 13 al. 1 let. a, p. 10) and the exemption of client-deposit interest up to CHF 200 a year (art. 5 al. 1 let. c, p. 4), for the état des titres and the refund it claims.
notes: Consolidated text, état le 1er janvier 2025, the latest consolidation on Fedlex on 13 October 2026 (found through the Fedlex SPARQL endpoint). 36 pages. Added by the securities agent.

title: Ordonnance relative à l'imputation d'impôts étrangers prélevés à la source (OIIS), RS 672.201
why_needed: Credit of foreign withholding tax (DA-1): who may claim it, income declared gross (art. 3, p. 3), deduction from gross income instead (art. 2 al. 3, p. 2), no credit when the non-recoverable taxes total CHF 100 or less (art. 7, p. 4), amount and maximum (art. 8 and 9, p. 5 and 6).
notes: Consolidated text, état le 1er janvier 2024, the latest consolidation on Fedlex on 13 October 2026. 12 pages. The list of treaty states and rates is in the DFF ordinance (ch-2025-oiis-dff-annexe). Added by the securities agent.

title: Ordonnance 1 du DFF relative à l'imputation d'impôts étrangers prélevés à la source, RS 672.201.1, avec son annexe (liste des États contractants)
why_needed: The non-recoverable foreign withholding tax rates per treaty state and kind of income (dividends, interest), which the DA-1 credit is computed from.
notes: État le 1er février 2026; the annex says it is valid for income due in 2025 (p. 2). The list for income due in 2026 is expected in early 2027 (each list is published the February after the income year): add it as ch-2026-oiis-dff-annexe. Notes A to E are on p. 10 to 18. The ESTV forms page (ch-na-formulaires-impot-federal-direct) links this ordinance as the official list for DA-1 to DA-3. Added by the securities agent.

title: Listes des cours pour l'évaluation des titres et des devises (ICTax)
why_needed: The official price list (Kursliste): closing prices of the last trading day of December, taxable value at 31 December (LHID art. 14 and 17 al. 1); searchable online by valor number or ISIN in ICTax (https://www.ictax.admin.ch/extern/fr.html). The extension never fetches it; the user looks values up.
notes: The page is rendered by JavaScript; the snapshot holds its summary text only. The ICTax application itself needs a browser. Added by the securities agent.

title: Structure et formats d'enregistrement des barèmes de l'impôt à la source pour l'importation dans les systèmes de comptabilité salariale (dès 2025)
why_needed: Record layout of the cantonal source-tax tariff files (tarjjkt.txt): fields, tariff codes, church-tax letter, monthly incomes.
notes: 11 pages, valid from 1 January 2025 (no later edition listed on https://www.estv.admin.ch/fr/baremes-impot-a-la-source-importation-systemes-de-comptabilite-salariale on 13 October 2026).

title: Loi fédérale sur la prévoyance professionnelle vieillesse, survivants et invalidité (LPP), RS 831.40
why_needed: Pension fund buy-ins (art. 79b): only up to the regulatory benefits, and no lump-sum withdrawal of bought-in benefits for three years.
notes: Consolidated text, état le 1er janvier 2025, the latest consolidation listed by Fedlex on 13 October 2026 (84 pages). Art. 79b starts on p. 65, al. 3 is on p. 66.

title: Ordonnance sur les déductions admises fiscalement pour les cotisations versées à des formes reconnues de prévoyance (OPP 3), RS 831.461.3
why_needed: Pillar 3a limits (art. 7) and the 3a catch-up payments (rachat, art. 7a and 7b) with its transitional provision (gaps from 2025 only).
notes: Consolidated text, état le 1er janvier 2025 (10 pages). Fedlex also lists a version applicable from 1 June 2027: re-check before the 2027 tax year.
